digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend facade and adapter layer
propositions: Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three opt-in capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must be defined in _backend.py with capability detection via isinstance() rather than capabilities() method.

JiraBackend thin wrapper delegates to existing Jira modules (AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields sanitizers, comment_limits) with zero behavior change and no core call-site rewiring.
RemoteRef dataclass and IdentityConvention pure convention object extract the inlined rebar-id label format/parse logic from four core sites but do not rewire those sites in this story.
Contract suite must pass when parameterized over both JiraBackend with injected mock transport and FakeBackend test double, verifying backend-agnostic behavior.
Characterization tests must assert pure Jira mapper outputs are byte-for-byte identical to current behavior for representative fixtures.
